channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Marquese Chriss | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Marquese Chriss from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Steve Kerr, Marquese Chriss
item.description:
Pop on Chriss:

“We receive a player who is a wonderful guy. I talked to Steve Kerr today. He had nothing but great things to say about him. He is hurt obviously, he has a broken leg, so we are going to have to wait to see what happens with that and where this goes.”

Gregg Popovich on Steve Kerr, Marquese Chriss, Mar 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney, Marquese Chriss, James Wiseman
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on a center rotation of Wiseman, Looney and Chriss:

“We anticipate all three of them playing. As always, we'll figure out who starts as we go.”

Steve Kerr on Kevon Looney, Marquese Chriss, James Wiseman, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Marquese Chriss
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Marquese Chriss:

“We're trying to push him because we think he can get a lot better.”

Steve Kerr on Marquese Chriss, Sep 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Marquese Chriss
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on whether it surprised him that Marquese Chriss was available on a two-way:

“It did. I guess the one thing that maybe hurt him in terms of not being picked up is just the trade deadline.... We're the beneficiaries of that.”

Steve Kerr on Marquese Chriss, Jan 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Marquese Chriss
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steve Kerr on Marquese Chriss:

“He’s got more skill as a passer and screener than I realized. And so we are very excited about that.”

Steve Kerr on Marquese Chriss, Oct 11, 2019. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.
